title: New in ChatGPT for Business: March 2025
summary: Join us as we share our latest releases and how ChatGPT is becoming more interactive, customized to the way your teams work, and agentic.
body: Join us as we share our latest releases and how ChatGPT is becoming more interactive, customized to the way your teams work, and agentic.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了2025年3月ChatGPT企业版的最新功能更新。此次更新重点强调了ChatGPT在企业环境中的交互性、团队定制化能力，以及向具备自主执行能力的Agent形态的演进，标志着企业级AI助理功能的进一步完善。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该官方公告发布了ChatGPT企业版在2025年3月的最新功能更新，重点展示了交互性提升、定制化以及向Agent方向演进的能力。
